sentence: Investment efficiency gains from AI concentrate where knowledge and R&D intensity are high and the internal controls sound
passage: [Lin, Li et al. (2026), p. 1] "The results show that AI can significantly enhance the investment efficiency of enterprises. This effect is more pronounced in high knowledge-intensity firms, high R&D-intensity firms, and firms with sound internal controls."

gemini.note: The passage states that the effect is 'more pronounced' in these firms, whereas the sentence shifts the emphasis by claiming the gains 'concentrate' there, which implies exclusivity rather than magnitude.
